name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: The exact C5 verifier enumerates every target-consistent positive labeled sample of size at most one and rejects every positive no-clashing map of width one. It returns an explicit positive no-clashing map of width two, so $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(C_5)=2$.
